canonical_project: GTA GU1 & GU2 Data Centers and Cable Landing Stations (Piti)
notes: GTA official page (checked 2026-08-12): GU1/GU2 are Tier 3-designed data centers and cable landing stations, carrier-neutral colocation with 2 MW across 11,800 sq ft, landing points for JGA North, JGA South and SEA-US, located in Piti.
